enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Breathes slowly. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Moves arm. Shifts legs. Turns again. Pulls blanket. Remains motionless. Snores lightly. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Remains still.

Opens eyes. Sits up. Swings legs over bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on faucet. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Picks up soap. Washes face. Rinses face. Turns off faucet. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out eggs. Closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl. Takes out pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Places eggs on plate. Pours milk into glass. Picks up fork. Eats eggs. Drinks milk. Picks up plate. Places plate in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses plate. Turns off tap.

Picks up bag. Walks out of house. Closes door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building. Walks to locker room. Opens locker. Changes into scrubs. Closes locker. Walks to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at station. Logs into computer. Reviews patient files. Washes hands. Puts on gloves. Enters patient room. Checks blood pressure. Listens to heart. Administers injection. Changes IV bag. Removes gloves. Washes hands. Answers phone. Takes notes. Attends meeting. Eats lunch. Returns to station. Updates patient records. Consults with colleague. Prepares equipment.

Leaves workplace. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to house. Opens door. Enters house. Closes door. Removes shoes. Hangs up coat.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out chicken. Closes refrigerator. Places chicken on cutting board. Cuts chicken. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours oil. Adds chicken. Stirs. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Picks up fork. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Picks up plate. Places plate in sink. Washes plate. Turns off tap.

Enters living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Puts down remote. Picks up laptop. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Logs in. Opens browser. Types on keyboard. Clicks mouse. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Continues typing. Turns off laptop. Closes laptop. Picks up remote. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime routine and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on faucet. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off faucet. Picks up towel. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

Enters bedroom. Closes door. Turns off light. Walks to bed. Pulls back blanket. Lies down. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes slowly. Turns to other side. Pulls blanket. Remains motionless.
